note: Pinned baseline of the Russian TTS normalization dictionaries. Data, not code: fix a rule by creating a new version of this file (the worker image pins the file). Author prosody markup is code, not data: stress marks (`+` before a Cyrillic stressed vowel -> U+0301 after the vowel) and pause markers (`[[pause:<seconds>]]`) are parsed by worker 0.4.0; the regexes/lists below only describe abbreviations, brands, numbers and the dictionary stress baseline. Explicit author stress wins over the dictionary entry and is protected from replacement. Gender/number agreement for numerals (один/одна) is intentionally not guessed: uncovered forms stay as written and are visible to QC.
